newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan's Elgrand, Cefiro Wagon sales beat target.
newsitem.headline: Nissan's Elgrand, Cefiro Wagon sales beat target.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd said on Friday it received 16,741 domestic orders for its new Elgrand luxury minivan in the month after its launch.
Nissan, Japan's second biggest carmaker, launched the Elgrand in Japan on May 19 with a monthly sales target of 5,000 units.

Elgrand is produced at the Shonan plant of Nissan Shatai Co Ltd. Nissan Shatai, owned 42.5 percent by Nissan, will operate the plant for four extra days in June and July to keep up with robust demand.
Nissan also said it received 3,114 domestic orders for its new Cefiro Wagon station wagon model in the first 20 days after its launch on June 2. The monthly target was 3,000 units.
Nissan's Oppama plant, near Tokyo, will operate for two extra days in July and four extra days in August.
